title: Miraculous Catch of Fish
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells the miraculous catch of fish (Luke 5:3-9) and names lessons: obey and trust Jesus, do not give up.

floor.question: What did Jesus do to the storm?

contexts: trying again after failing a test

board.say: What happened when Simon obeyed Jesus?

board.do: Wait for the child to say they caught many fish.

misconceptions.ask: How many fish had Simon caught during the night?
Where did Jesus tell Simon to let down the nets?
How many fish did they catch?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 5:6-7 and draw two overloaded boats.

misconceptions.ask: What did Simon do when Jesus told him to fish again?

checks.question: What did Simon catch in the night?
Name a lesson from the story.
